senses.gloss: f. (√כו, v. כבב, to be arched, hollow) = h. חַלּוֹן, aperture, window.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Zephaniah 2:14">Targ. Zeph. II, 14</cite> (ed. Lag. <cite ref="K00204"><he>כַּוָּה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 7:6">Targ. Prov. VII, 6</cite> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <cite ref="K00719"><he>כַּוַּיָּא</he></cite> pl.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 13:3">Targ. Hos. XIII, 3</cite> <he>כַּוַּת נורא</he> smoke-hole; a. e.—

<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:9">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כוותא דדשא</he> Ar. a. Rashi Ms. (ed. <cite ref="S00048"><he>קביותא</he></cite>, Ms. M. <cite ref="S00031"><he>קבוותא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the arch of the door, upper door-post.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 4:12:2">Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אודיק ר׳ מן כ׳</he> Rabbi looked out of the window.
Sabb. 35ᵃ וסימניך כ׳ (or כַּוָּותָא pl.) thy sign by which to remember be ‘window’ (which reflects the light of the setting sun); a. fr.—Pl. כַּוִּוין, כַּוַּויָּא, כַּוָּותָא, כַּוֵּי &c.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 6:4">Targ. I Kings VI, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 49:22">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIX, 22</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:9">Targ. Cant. II, 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 6a:9">B. Bath. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>בֵּי כַּוֵּי לא וכ׳</he> apertures in the party wall (for beam-rests) are no evidence of the neighbor’s share in the wall.
Ib. 75ᵃ כ׳ דבי זיקא (Ms. O. כַּוֵּי זיקא) apertures for the air (windows, contrad. to openings for doors).—Hebr. pl. כַּוִּין.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 309:7">Sifré Deut. 309</cite> (play on <he>ויכוננך</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:6">Deut. XXXII, 6</cite>) <he>עשאך כ׳ כ׳</he> he made thy body full of cavities (v. Pesik. Zutr. ed. Bub., Deut. p. 111); Yalk. ib. 942 <he>כיון כיון</he> (corr. acc.).
